title: Block ka Dessa - AI jo hasta hai, rukta hai, insaan jaisa bolta hai
content:
Ek AI voice jo HASTI HAI, RUKTI HAI, aur rooti bhi hai. Bilkul insaan jaisi.
Jack Dorsey ki company Block ne ek naya voice model dikhaya hai. Naam hai Dessa.
TechCrunch ke mutabik ye model poori tarah human speech pe train hua hai.
Aur Block kehti hai ki ise ek single NVIDIA GPU rack pe train kiya gaya.
Ab ek technical word samjho. Full-duplex.
Iska matlab ye model bolte bolte sun bhi sakta hai. Exactly like a real phone call.
Aap beech mein tok do, toh woh ruk ke react karega.
Doosri badi baat. Block ke hisaab se ye model LOCALLY chal sakta hai, ek MacBook M4 Max ya usse better machine pe.
Matlab cloud ki zaroorat nahi. Aapki AWAAZ aapke laptop pe hi rahegi.
Lekin ruko. Kya aap ise abhi use kar sakte ho? NAHI.
There is no public access yet. Block ne abhi sirf safety researchers ko test karne ke liye bulaya hai.
TechCrunch ka kehna hai ki shayad ye test karne ke liye ki voice agent logon ko phone pe dhokha na de paaye.
Toh aapke liye iska matlab kya?
Pehla, voice agents ab robotic nahi lagenge. Customer support, bookings, appointments, sab voice pe shift ho sakta hai.
Maan lo ek clinic hai jahan din bhar phone bajta hai. Ek natural voice agent appointments le sakta hai, aur doctor ka time bachega.
Doosra, scams bhi badhenge. Agar AI itni real lagti hai, toh family ke saath ek CODE WORD decide karo, taaki fake call pakad sako.
Aaj kya karein? Apne business ki top ten phone queries likho. Wahi aapke future voice agent ki script banegi.
And when tools like this open up, you will be ready on day one.
Mera take simple hai.
Next big AI interface screen nahi, AWAAZ hogi. Aur trust sabse bada feature hoga.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
